system.description: Arcanists approach supernatural power as something that can be studied, constructed, and refined. Their Actions shape magical forces and create Threads that interact with later spellwork.
system.benefit: Gain access to the Magecraft Combat Style. If this Distinction is acquired later, gain access to Magecraft, increase it to Rank 2, then gain one additional Magecraft Expertise and two additional Magecraft Combat Cards.

origin.name: Elemental Versatility
origin.text: The first time you use an Action Card of a particular Magecraft subtype during an Encounter, gain one additional Surge for that Action.
